mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an excellent reducing agent for dichromate."
Ferrous ion is an excellent reducing agent for dichromate.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of the course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of the course.

The guard column is an inexpensive column placed before the analytical column (a more expensive column), protecting it from contamination and damage, while the analytical column does the separation.
